name: Kurose Mayumi
source:
After completing her tenure at Himejima Academy, she returns to her former school as vice principal.

In order to fulfill her own wish, she makes a deal with Himejima Academy to provide education as a sex educator.

She has a son, but for some reason she is unable to see him.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/jmkyoutou/jmkyoutou.html]official site[/url]]
